capabilities.title: Durable local conversation and built-in skill registry
capabilities.contract: Every Article has one persisted greeting and stable contracts for six skills. Assistant requests are revision-bound, resolve one eligible explicit or inferred skill, and retain completed local messages and review artifacts.
capabilities.persistence: Assistant messages, requests, and completed artifacts persist locally. Workflow Stage persistence is retired; legacy values remain untouched.

capabilities.title: Streamed responses, progress, cancellation, and error recovery
capabilities.contract: Assistant requests stream typed status and response events; incomplete streams do not modify an Article.
capabilities.persistence: Only valid completed request output becomes local message or review-artifact state.

capabilities.title: Thesis-to-narrative composition
capabilities.contract: The server creates a composition Proposal from author-supplied theses; it remains reviewable until acceptance.
capabilities.persistence: Completed proposal artifacts are local and revision-bound.

capabilities.title: Flow revision
capabilities.contract: Flow revision generates a full-text Proposal rather than silently editing the Article.
capabilities.persistence: Completed proposal artifacts are local and revision-bound.

capabilities.title: Fact-check request
capabilities.contract: A fixed server-side fact-check workflow creates advisory, Revision-tied findings with their own freshness state.
capabilities.persistence: Findings and citations are stored locally without changing Article text.

capabilities.title: Style review
capabilities.contract: Style review uses a compact derived profile; raw style samples remain local and review findings retain freshness state.
capabilities.persistence: Raw style corpus and derived review artifacts stay local.

capabilities.title: Translation request
capabilities.contract: Translation requests prepare linked Article content; the source Article is never overwritten.
capabilities.persistence: Translation review metadata is local and source linkage remains recoverable.

capabilities.title: Diff review, selection, acceptance, rejection, and stale protection
capabilities.contract: Authors may review diffs, select changes, accept or reject proposals, and cannot accept a stale proposal.
capabilities.persistence: Acceptance creates one immutable Revision; rejection leaves Article history unchanged.

capabilities.title: Explicit request and explicit proposal approval
capabilities.contract: AI operations require an author request; generated text remains separate until explicit author acceptance.
capabilities.persistence: Only accepted content creates a Revision.

capabilities.title: Named OpenAI connections and environment-variable references
capabilities.contract: Authors configure named OpenAI connections, active selection, testing, and environment-variable names without exposing secret values.
capabilities.persistence: Connection metadata and active selection persist locally; credentials remain environment-provided.
limitations: Connection management and provider breadth remain incomplete.

capabilities.title: Refreshed model list, default model, and skill-specific overrides
capabilities.contract: A default model and built-in-skill overrides determine new editorial requests.
capabilities.persistence: Model preferences persist locally; refreshed provider model lists are not persisted.

scenarios.title: Assistant request produces a revision-bound proposal
preconditions: The author has an Article and requests a selected-text improvement.
scenarios.event: The Assistant resolves an eligible skill and completes its request.
expected: The request, messages, and revision-bound Proposal artifact are retained locally.
forbidden: The source Article text is not silently changed.

scenarios.title: Failed or cancelled Assistant work remains recoverable
preconditions: An Assistant or editorial stream is in progress.
scenarios.event: The stream fails, is incomplete, or is cancelled.
expected: A stable error can be shown and unfinished output is not persisted as valid work.
forbidden: The Article is not modified by incomplete output.

scenarios.title: Composition and flow revision remain proposals
preconditions: The author explicitly requests an editorial operation.
scenarios.event: The server completes a composition or flow-revision operation.
expected: A reviewable Proposal is produced with the source Article unchanged.
forbidden: Generated text is not applied without author approval.

scenarios.title: Fact and style review preserve Article text
preconditions: The author explicitly requests a fact or style review.
expected: Revision-tied advisory findings and citations are retained.
forbidden: Review output does not overwrite Article text or send raw style corpus text.

scenarios.title: Translation retains source independence
preconditions: The author explicitly requests a translation target language.
scenarios.event: The translation operation completes and the author creates its linked Article.
expected: The linked translation retains source metadata and protected spans.
forbidden: The source Article is not overwritten.

scenarios.title: Stale proposal remains reviewable but cannot be accepted
preconditions: A Proposal base Revision is no longer current.
expected: The stale warning is shown and rejection remains available.
forbidden: Acceptance cannot create a Revision from a stale Proposal.

scenarios.title: Connection metadata stays distinct from secrets
preconditions: The author configures OpenAI connection metadata.
scenarios.event: The author adds, selects, or removes a connection.
expected: Only environment-variable references and active connection metadata persist.
forbidden: Secret values are not stored or exposed.

scenarios.title: Model preferences resolve for new requests
preconditions: A default model or skill-specific override is configured.
scenarios.event: A new editorial request resolves its model.
expected: The applicable override or default model is selected.
forbidden: A refreshed provider list is not treated as persisted preference data.
